text:
nora: Heads-up: soft-launch webinar next Tue 11am PT (studio format, 75 seats). Need: final reg page copy, HubSpot mapping, Zoom layout + recording plan, captions, and short-clip workflow. Can we finalize by Fri EOD?

sam_eventops: I can run the OBS recorder VM as co-host. Recommend scene: slides + speaker spotlight, record 1080p master. Enable cloud recording as fallback.

diego: Reg page copy note: use 'Reserve a seat' CTA, show three timezone labels. Include a consent checkbox: 'I agree this session may be recorded and used for Redwood marketing.' Hidden fields: utm_campaign=mini_launch, source=email.

emma: Post-event: gated replay for registrants, three promo clips (30s), full transcript and captions. Suggest pipeline: Zoom webhook -> S3 -> AssemblyAI -> clips via ffmpeg. I'll own clip selection.

sam_eventops: Ops checklist:
- diego publish reg page + HubSpot form (with hidden fields)
- sam provision OBS VM and test scenes (24h before)
- emma create clip timestamps and request edits
- nora confirm speaker names and lower-thirds

zoombot: Zoom meeting created (id=1122334455). Cloud recording enabled; transcripts on.

nora: Owners: diego (page), sam (recording), emma (clips), me (program lead). Please confirm by Fri noon. :thumbsup:

diego: Confirmed, will drop draft copy in #marketing-assets Thu morning.

emma: Confirmed, will build clip template and ffmpeg example.

sam_eventops: Confirmed, scheduling dry-run Wed.

nora: Great, locking plan unless blockers.
